request.purpose: Advisory review of complete cloud knowledge-stack pilot choices; no execution authorization

state.stage: design only; no corpus or deployment; future phases must each cover sources, graph+retrieval, all HW levels, kernels, HAT, metrics, Melete and feedback
state.priorities: quality and evidence correctness before latency and cost; all metric dimensions retained; no cloud/region/budget selected; staff operations capacity unknown
state.known_context: Company uses Supabase and Neo4j for Confluence RAG, but project access/accounts/data not granted.
nonnegotiable: no graph-retrieval score as physical proof
no perpetual GPU/Kubernetes assumed for a small pilot

managed_projection.components: Managed PostgreSQL (Supabase candidate) canonical ledger + pgvector/native full-text baseline; Neo4j Aura evidence-bearing graph projection; same-provider/region object storage+Parquet; provider Batch/workflow; Docling and BGE/Qwen/API bake-off.
managed_projection.strengths: Fits existing familiarity and explicit graph traversal while preserving exportable SoR; extra search DB optional.
managed_projection.risks: Multi-provider network/ACL/backup consistency; region/private endpoint requires higher editions; no proven cost quote.
managed_projection.phase_fit: Small full-flow pilot; re-evaluate scale and formal RDF needs.

native_cloud.components: One AWS account hierarchy with managed Postgres, S3, Neptune, provider jobs; optional OpenSearch after lexical scale evidence.
native_cloud.risks: Provider-specific graph/query/ops, overlapping stores, minimum provisioned costs; no operator preference.

semantic_rdf.components: Managed PostgreSQL ledger + RDF/SPARQL/SHACL projection using Stardog or Jena + object store; vector/lexical selected independently.
semantic_rdf.strengths: Explicit semantic/schema interoperability and shape reasoning.
semantic_rdf.risks: Additional mapping and SPARQL skill; Stardog quote/Jena ops; not a substitute for numeric/physical validators.

portable_selfhost.risks: Most operational ownership, upgrade/HA/security/load unknown; no operating team or cost proof.

pilot_choice.instructions: Choose which stack to evaluate FIRST for a small but real full-flow pilot, not which production stack is proven best. Quality first, then operational feasibility; unfamiliar operations team and unverified private connectivity matter. Do not infer existing account access.

criteria.managed_projection: Evaluate the managed Postgres plus Neo4j projection stack first.
criteria.native_cloud: Evaluate one native cloud stack first.
criteria.semantic_rdf: Evaluate an RDF semantic projection stack first.
criteria.portable_selfhost: Evaluate a portable self-hosted orchestration stack first.

managed_readiness.instructions: Score documentary readiness of managed_projection for detailed planning; distinguish functional fit from deployment or measured performance readiness.
criteria: 3: coherent planning candidate with explicit external gates
4: validated interfaces and costs for the target

complete_plan.instructions: Do these candidate descriptions alone justify provisioning cloud resources now? The user forbids implementation until full design and plans are reviewed.
